subject: Social Media
title: The Algorithmic Shift
description: A quick, practical guide to The Algorithmic Shift.

hook.text: In 2016, Instagram ditched chronological order. Millions signed petitions. Nobody listened.

buildup.text: Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn—one by one, every platform chose algorithms over timelines.

discovery.text: Algorithmic feeds boost engagement by 40%. Users see content they prefer—even if they didn't choose it.

twist.text: Creators suffered most. Reach became random. A post seen by thousands one day vanished the next.

climax.text: Users said they hated algorithms. But data told another story. People scrolled longer on ranked feeds.

punchline.text: We voted with our thumbs, not our words.

quiz.question: How much did algorithmic feeds boost engagement?
